---
title: "HAB Distance — ECDF and KDE Plots"
output: html_notebook
---

## Setup — Load Data

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

load("8.17.25MLWork.RData")
load("RData")
```

## Prepare Weighted Data

```{r prepare-data}
# Weighted CDF data
weighted_cdf <- combined_dist_data %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    weight = COUNT_chla / sum(COUNT_chla, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(NEAR_DIST) %>%
  mutate(
    cdf = cumsum(weight)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Line types: solid for all years, dashed for 2020 and 2023
years <- sort(unique(weighted_cdf$year))
line_types <- rep("solid", length(years))
names(line_types) <- years
line_types[c("2020", "2023")] <- "dashed"
```

## Plot 1 — ECDF by Year

```{r ecdf-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(combined_dist_data, aes(x = NEAR_DIST, color = factor(year))) +

  # Shade 0–10 km region
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = 0, xmax = 10,
           ymin = 0, ymax = 1,
           fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.4) +

  # ECDF curves
  stat_ecdf(size = 1) +

  labs(
    title = "Cumulative Distribution Function",
    x = "Distance from Source (km)",
    y = "Empirical Cumulative Distribution",
    color = "Year"
  ) +

  theme_minimal()
```

## Plot 2 — Weighted KDE by Year

```{r kde-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
# Line types for weighted_data
years_wd <- sort(unique(weighted_data$year))
line_types_wd <- rep("solid", length(years_wd))
names(line_types_wd) <- years_wd
line_types_wd[c("2020", "2023")] <- "dashed"

ggplot(weighted_data, aes(x = NEAR_DIST,
                           weight = weight,
                           color = factor(year),
                           linetype = factor(year))) +

  # Shade 0–10 km region
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = 0, xmax = 10,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.4) +

  # Weighted KDE curves
  geom_density(size = 1.1) +

  scale_linetype_manual(values = line_types_wd) +

  labs(
    title = "Weighted KDE of HAB Distance by Year",
    x = "Distance from Source (km)",
    y = "Density (Fraction of Total HABs)",
    color = "Year",
    linetype = "Year"
  ) +

  theme_minimal()
```

save.image(file = "KDEplot.RData")
